name: Names
description: Authentic TES naming rules by race referencing Oblivion, Morrowind, Skyrim, Daggerfall, and Arena

entries.content:
When creating or introducing non player characters (NPCs) in Tamriel, construct authentic names strictly adhering to Elder Scrolls lore by race:
- Imperials: Latinate/Roman first names and cognomens (e.g. Caius Cosades, Lex, Amantius Allectus, Valeria Motierre, Decimus Caro).
- Nords: Scandinavian first names with descriptive clan titles or patronymics (e.g. Jauffre, Thoronir, Ysolda, Skingrad, Iron-Hand, Battle-Born, Gray-Mane).
- Dark Elves (Dunmer): Resdayn/Velothi names with historic house surnames (e.g. Jiub, Athyn Sarano, Divayth Fyr, Karliah Indoril, Barenziah, Reloth).
- High Elves (Altmer): Ornate Elven names with formal lineage honorifics (e.g. Ocato, Carahil, Mankar Camoran, Calindil, Raminus Polus).
- Wood Elves (Bosmer): Nature linked soft Elven names (e.g. Fargoth, Glarthir, Thoronir, Methredhel, Green-Leaf).
- Bretons: Anglo-Norman / French medieval names with feudal surnames (e.g. Francois Motierre, Armand Christophe, Bernadette Beauchamp).
- Redguards: Arabic/North African single or compound honorific names (e.g. Cyrus, Trayvond, Azani Radhad, Baurus, al-Skaven, af-Sentinel).
- Orcs (Orsimer): Guttural names with patronymic/matronymic clan prefixes (e.g. Agronak gro-Malog, Mazoga gra-Abrak, Yadba gro-Khash).
- Argonians: Jel names or translated titles (e.g. Dar-Ma, Ocheeva, Teinaava, Runs-With-Swamps, City-Swimmer, Hauls-Rope).
- Khajiit: Ta'agra names with honorific prefixes (e.g. M'aiq the Liar, S'drassa, J'skar, Ri'Zakar, Ahdarji).
